pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging or pyramiding into trades exhibiting high-frequency retracement wicks; scaling allowed only after 3R unrealized structural confirmation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandate a minimum 22-pip structural volatility buffer below local order-block extremes before initial market placement to prevent session-close wick hunting.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume upon reaching $7.50 profit, leaving the remainder on a dynamic trailing stop to capture extended $15-$30+ runs.
